item.text:
**Overall:** Yes, with caveats. Lula’s 2024 record shows a real turn toward measurement, conditionality tracking, transparency, and institutional correction in social-service delivery, especially in Bolsa Família, health infrastructure, sanitation, and school/housing programs. The main caveat is that some of the strongest positive signals come from official government sources, while independent reporting still found major gaps in remote and vulnerable areas.

**Evidence For**
- **Decreto nº 12.064, de 17 de junho de 2024** | Presidência da República | 2024-06-17 | https://www.presidencia.gov.br/Ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12064.htm  
  The Bolsa Família decree formally ties the program to health, education, and social-assistance conditionalities, with MDS, MEC, MS, and federative entities sharing monitoring duties. This is evidence of rule-based program management rather than ad hoc patronage. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **Portaria MDS sobre o IGD / gestão do Bolsa Família** | Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social | 2024-12-23 | https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/acoes-e-programas/bolsa-familia/original/privados/igd/portaria  
  The ministry frames Bolsa Família management around CadÚnico updates, health/education monitoring, and active follow-up of vulnerable families, which is a technocratic feedback loop for service delivery. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **CGU Presente: Controladoria-Geral da União avalia condições de permanência do Programa Bolsa Família** | CGU | 2024-12-09 | https://www.gov.br/cgu/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/12/cgu-presente-controladoria-geral-da-uniao-avalia-condicoes-de-permanencia-do-programa-bolsa-familia  
  CGU reviewed whether monitoring was actually identifying and supporting beneficiaries, which is direct evidence of oversight, measurement, and corrective review. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`
- **Presidente Lula assina decreto que atualiza regras para a implementação de políticas públicas em parcerias com as organizações da sociedade civil** | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-03-13 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-atualiza-regras-para-a-implementacao-de-politicas-publicas-em-parcerias-com-as-organizacoes-da-sociedade-civil  
  Lula updated the partnership framework to improve implementation and democratize access, a sign of using formal procedures and civic partnerships to improve delivery. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.1`
- **Assessorias criadas pelo presidente devem fortalecer participação social nas políticas públicas do governo federal** | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-03-26 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/assessorias-criadas-pelo-presidente-devem-fortalecer-participacao-social-nas-politicas-publicas-do-governo-federal  
  The new social-participation/diversity offices are explicitly meant to structure monitoring and dialogue across ministries, which is a correction-capacity signal rather than propaganda. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`
- **Novo PAC Seleções vai investir R$ 23 bilhões em saúde, educação, esporte e cultura** | Casa Civil | 2024-03-07 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura  
  The PAC pipeline targets UBS units, schools, creches, SAMU ambulances, and related infrastructure through formal allocations, which is consistent with programmatic delivery backed by administrative planning. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **Novo PAC Seleções vai investir R$ 41,7 bi em transporte, drenagem, esgotamento sanitário, abastecimento de água e infraestrutura social nas cidades** | Casa Civil | 2024-07-26 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades  
  This is evidence of structured investment in water, sanitation, drainage, and social infrastructure, with the state using formal spending lines rather than opaque discretion. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **ANA publica norma de referência sobre universalização dos serviços de abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário** | ANA | 2024-05-10 | https://www.gov.br/ana/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-e-eventos/noticias/ana-publica-norma-de-referencia-sobre-universalizacao-dos-servicos-de-abastecimento-de-agua-e-esgotamento-sanitario  
  ANA set universalization targets and emphasized low-income and rural access, which is exactly the kind of measurement framework a correction-oriented ruler would use. `6B.5`, also `6B.2`
- **SINISA** | Ministério das Cidades | 2024-04-04 | https://www.gov.br/cidades/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/saneamento/sinisa/sinisa-1/sinisa  
  SINISA was built to collect and organize data on water, sewage, drainage, and rural sanitation, giving the state a measurement base for service-delivery correction. `6B.5`, also `6B.2`
- **Lei nº 15.012** | Presidência da República | 2024-11-04 | https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/lei/l15012.htm  
  The law requires publication of sanitation documents and periodic reservoir-security reports, which improves transparency and service oversight. `6B.5`, also `6B.2`
- **Decreto institui o Sistema Nacional de Acompanhamento e Combate à Violência nas Escolas (SNAVE)** | Presidência da República | 2024-04-24 | https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm  
  SNAVE creates a reporting and response system for school violence, showing a targeted monitoring architecture for child safety and school services. `6B.5`, also `6B.3`, `6B.2`
- **Saiba mais sobre as ações do Ministério da Saúde voltadas às pessoas com deficiência** | Ministério da Saúde | 2024-12-03 | https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/dezembro/saiba-mais-sobre-as-acoes-do-ministerio-da-saude-voltadas-as-pessoas-com-deficiencia  
  The disability-care network expansion, rehab centers, and adapted transport suggest sectoral planning and professional service optimization. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **Presidente Lula entrega novas moradias à população do Rio Grande do Sul** | Presidência da República / Reconstrução RS | 2024-08-16 | https://www.gov.br/reconstrucaors/pt-br/acompanhe-a-reconstrucao/noticias/presidente-lula-entrega-novas-moradias-a-populacao-do-rio-grande-do-sul  
  The flood response included immediate housing delivery plus a year-end completion target, which is a concrete example of correcting delivery after a shock. `6B.5`, also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

**Evidence Against / Caveats**
- **Brazil looks at curbing health, education spending in fiscal package, sources say** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/forex-news/brazil-looks-at-curbing-health-education-spending-in-fiscal-package-sources-say-3703870  
  Even with a reformist delivery agenda, fiscal pressure threatened health and education outlays, which weakens any claim of fully stable correction-oriented governance. `6B.5`, also `6B.2`, `6B.4`
- **Brazil’s government improves fiscal outlook for the year, but still needs spending freeze** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-government-improves-fiscal-outlook-for-the-year-3626553  
  The need for a spending freeze shows reactive adjustment under strain, not a clean evidence-led service machine. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **Analysis: Brazil’s tinkering to meet fiscal target threatens to dent credibility** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-18 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814  
  Reuters’ criticism of creative accounting is the strongest broad caveat against transparent correction in Lula’s macro management, with spillovers for service delivery credibility. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`
- **Lula publicly pressed the central bank** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-07-01 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm  
  This is not a service-delivery item directly, but it shows Lula still used political pressure in policy disputes, which is a cautionary sign for evidence-led governance generally. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`
- **Yanomami crisis remained severe** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-01-26 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/01/26/crise-do-povo-yanomami-persiste-apos-308-mortes-em-2023-diz-relatorio.htm  
  The Yanomami case is the clearest delivery failure: even after emergency action, invasion, malnutrition, disease, and violence persisted, showing correction was incomplete. `6B.5`, also `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- **Human Rights Watch on police abuse** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-15 / 2025-01-01 covering 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence / https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil  
  HRW’s account of lethal raids and disproportionate police killings is a reminder that monitoring and correction were not strong enough in all service-adjacent state functions. `6B.5`, also `6B.3`, `6B.4`
- **Amazon water shortages** | Reuters via Investing.com / Reuters Connect | 2024-09-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/amazon-rivers-low-water-levels-bring-fresh-challenges-for-locals-3606308 / https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/drought-in-brazilian-amazon-causes-water-shortage-for-elderly-and-sick/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjQ6bmV3c21sX1ZBMjU1NzA4MDkyMDI0UlAx  
  Remote communities still lacked reliable drinking water, so the delivery system clearly had geographic blind spots even amid better national-level measurement. `6B.5`, also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

**Search gap**
- The strongest evidence is about system design: conditionalities, registries, oversight, data systems, and transparency laws.
- I found less independent auditing of whether Lula’s corrections actually improved service outcomes across the whole country; many of the best data points are government-issued.
- The negative evidence is clearest in remote Indigenous and Amazon contexts, where implementation lagged behind the formal measurement and correction architecture.
